title: Who Makes the Decision? Auditing an Agentic LLM Pipeline for Illicit Cryptocurrency Transaction Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2611.29829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic pipelines that combine graph detectors, deterministic rules, retrieval-augmented generation and an LLM judge are being proposed to monitor illicit cryptocurrency flows and to write regulation-citing justifications for analysts. They are evaluated on end-to-end accuracy or on the quality of those justifications, and neither shows which component made a decision. We audit such a pipeline on the Elliptic++ Bitcoin dataset with decision-source attribution, a trace-level protocol with three layers: per-case actual causation, interventional Shapley credit, and mediation of upstream risk scores. A deterministic wallet-score override carries about 94% of the credit for flags, and a verification gate cancels most of the judge's own flags, which fall on licit transactions. Testing the judge alone over 76 evidence bundles, four backbones and two prompts, we find that it follows an injected risk score on the anonymous transaction features it

translated_title: 谁在做决策？审计用于非法加密货币交易监测的智能体化LLM流水线
translated_abstract: 结合图检测器、确定性规则、检索增强生成和LLM裁判的智能体化流水线正被提出用于监测非法加密货币资金流动，并为分析师撰写引用法规的正当性说明。这类流水线通常在端到端准确率或说明文本质量上进行评估，但这两种评估方式都无法揭示究竟是哪个组件做出了决策。我们在Elliptic++比特币数据集上使用决策来源归因方法审计了这样一个流水线——这是一个包含三个层面的追踪级审计协议：逐案例的实际因果分析、干预式Shapley贡献度分配，以及上游风险评分的中介效应分析。审计结果表明，确定性的钱包评分覆盖机制承担了约94%的标记决策贡献，而验证门控取消了LLM裁判自身的大部分标记，且这些标记原本落在合法交易上。在76个证据包、四个骨干模型和两种提示词配置下对LLM裁判进行单独测试时，我们发现它会跟随注入的风险评分，针对它所面对的匿名交易特征……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出决策来源归因审计方法，发现非法加密货币交易监测的智能体化LLM流水线中，真正的决策主要由确定性规则而非LLM裁判做出，且LLM裁判会盲目跟随注入的风险评分。
en_tdlr: Using decision-source attribution, this paper audits an agentic LLM pipeline for illicit cryptocurrency transaction monitoring and reveals that deterministic rules—not the LLM judge—make most decisions, while the judge blindly follows injected risk scores.
